title: Petition of Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company, requesting authority from the Department, pursuant to Chapter 164, Section 75C for the right to exercise the power of eminent domain such rights of way, permanent easements temprory easements or such other interests to land or other property necessary for the construction, operation, maintenance, alteration and/or removal of natural gas transmission pipelines, appliances, appurtenances and other equipment situated in the Town of Pittsfield in the County of Berkshire.
